title.en: See the SSH handshake in detail

why.en: ssh -v shows the banner exchange, KEXINIT algorithm choice, host key check and auth methods. Use a machine you own; the login attempt below is only against your own computer.
why.hinglish: ssh -v banner exchange, KEXINIT algorithm choice, host key check aur auth methods dikhata hai. Apni hi machine use karo; neeche ka login attempt sirf aapke apne computer par hai.

expect.en: Debug lines such as 'Remote protocol version 2.0', 'kex: algorithm: curve25519-sha256', 'Server host key: ssh-ed25519 SHA256:...' and 'Authentications that can continue: publickey'. If you have no SSH server on your machine you will just see 'Connection refused', which is fine. Output varies by version.
expect.hinglish: 'Remote protocol version 2.0', 'kex: algorithm: curve25519-sha256', 'Server host key: ssh-ed25519 SHA256:...' aur 'Authentications that can continue: publickey' jaisi debug lines. Agar aapki machine par SSH server nahi hai to bas 'Connection refused' dikhega, jo theek hai. Output version ke hisaab se badalta hai.

title.en: List the host keys you already trust
title.hinglish: Wo host keys dekho jin par aap pehle se bharosa karte ho

why.en: known_hosts is where SSH remembers each server's fingerprint (trust on first use). A changed fingerprint triggers the warning in the host-key scenario.
why.hinglish: known_hosts wo jagah hai jahan SSH har server ka fingerprint yaad rakhta hai (trust on first use). Fingerprint badalne par host-key scenario wali warning aati hai.

expect.en: One line per saved server: key size, SHA256 fingerprint, host and key type (for example ED25519). It may be empty or missing if you have never used SSH.
expect.hinglish: Har saved server ki ek line: key size, SHA256 fingerprint, host aur key type (jaise ED25519). Agar aapne kabhi SSH use nahi kiya to khali ya missing ho sakta hai.

title.en: Show your own public key fingerprint
title.hinglish: Apni public key ka fingerprint dikhao

why.en: Key login uses a key pair. This prints the fingerprint of your public key only, never the private key.
why.hinglish: Key login key pair use karta hai. Ye sirf aapki public key ka fingerprint print karta hai, private key kabhi nahi.

expect.en: A line like '256 SHA256:... you@host (ED25519)'. If you have no key, you get 'No such file'; create one with ssh-keygen -t ed25519.
expect.hinglish: '256 SHA256:... you@host (ED25519)' jaisi line. Agar key nahi hai to 'No such file' aayega; ssh-keygen -t ed25519 se bana lo.

title.en: Find the KEXINIT and key exchange in the capture
title.hinglish: Capture mein KEXINIT aur key exchange dhoondo

why.en: Open the lesson's .pcap in Wireshark. Banners and key exchange are readable; after NEWKEYS everything is encrypted.
why.hinglish: Lesson ka .pcap Wireshark mein kholo. Banners aur key exchange padhe ja sakte hain; NEWKEYS ke baad sab encrypted hai.

expect.en: KEXINIT (20), the ECDH init and reply (30, 31) and NEWKEYS (21). Later packets show only 'Encrypted packet'.
expect.hinglish: KEXINIT (20), ECDH init aur reply (30, 31) aur NEWKEYS (21). Baad ke packets mein sirf 'Encrypted packet' dikhta hai.
